install.label: 03 / installation
install.heading: Take your time with the surface.
install.step_1_text: Carefully remove all existing skates, including any double-sided adhesive. Make sure no residue is left behind.
install.step_2_text: Wipe each skate slot with the alcohol pad to remove dust, oils or adhesive residue. Let it dry completely.
install.step_3_text: Choose the right size dot. Align each dot with the edge of the mouse for balance and stability.
install.step_4_text: Once all dots are in place, press firmly on each one for a few seconds to make sure it bonds.

origin.label: 04 / the origin
origin.quote: “rawdot began from a practical problem: replacing worn mouse skates in Mexico was often more complicated than the product itself.”
origin.description: Gaming mice can last for years while their original skates gradually wear down. Universal dots became a more flexible alternative—one created from the perspective of a gamer in Mexico.
origin.principle_1_description: Choose placement instead of depending on one exact shape.
origin.principle_3_description: Product, packaging, and instructions made easier to understand.
origin.principle_4_description: A quality replacement without unnecessary complexity.

faq.label: 05 / questions
faq.heading: Keep it simple.
faq.description: Useful answers, without the gaming-store noise.
faq.q1: What are universal mouse skate dots?
faq.a1: Small circular skates that can be placed around different mouse shapes, rather than matching one exact model.
faq.q2: Will the Ice Version fit my mouse?
faq.a2: Universal dots are designed for flexible placement across many mouse shapes. Keep the mouse stable and leave the sensor unobstructed.
faq.q3: How many dots should I use?
faq.a3: Start with balanced placement around the outer contact areas and adjust only when necessary. There is no single number for every mouse.
faq.q4: What surfaces is the Ice Version designed for?
faq.a5: 20 PTFE dots and one individually wrapped isopropyl alcohol prep pad.
faq.a6: Choose the Ice Version at the top of the page, add it to your cart and continue to secure checkout.
